The '''CR-24 Flame Rifle''' was an incendiary weapon produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]]. Its [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] counterpart was known as the [[CZ-24 Flamemaster flame rifle]]. The rifle had a fire range of 10 meters which meant the CR-24 was better utilized for close combat.<ref name="EGWT" />

A larger military version of the [[Model C-22 flame carbine]], the CR-24 was likewise a popular choice among [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] forces.
